page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Headings DECRETUM and EVENTUS are set in spaced capitals. The left edge of the scan is cut off, so the line beginnings are fragments.

p.i: Alii ex aduerso id minus tutum existi- mabant.

main_text.p: Enim nihil se militi debere asseverabant, um quam certa sint stipendia; tam tutam eos debere esse Civium agrestiumque nam.

. Non fieri contractu legitimum debere, ante contractum illegitimum & iniquum fier fit. Quamdiu illicitum manear in bona um & agrestium graffari, ab eo flagitio nere aliquando bonos aut mitius agere. vero fiat licitum per mutuos contractus, os pariter ac malos ex contractus lege de- fibi ut licita exacturos.

I. Neque facile futurum finem licentiae taris, qui ante contractum iniqui, quidni n iniqui post eum futuri credantur. Itaque ilitari disciplinae Castrorum & unius cu- ue inductriae privatim prævenienda hæc na aut minuenda potius relinquerentur.

page.notes: The left edge of every line is cut off by the scan, so line beginnings are incomplete and are given only as far as they are visible. The page number "115" at the top right is partly obscured and is read as 115 with some doubt. Some words are read with uncertainty, notably "fier fit", "tam tutam", "de- fibi", "inductriae" (printed "induftriae"), and "exacturos". Printed long s is rendered as s throughout.
